title: 셸 정렬
description: 간격을 줄여 가며 삽입 정렬을 수행하는 과정을 확인합니다.
source_code:
numbers = [8, 5, 3, 7, 6, 2]
gap = len(numbers) // 2
while gap > 0:
    for i in range(gap, len(numbers)):
        temp = numbers[i]
        j = i
        while j >= gap and numbers[j - gap] > temp:
            numbers[j] = numbers[j - gap]
            j -= gap
        numbers[j] = temp
    gap //= 2
print(numbers)

title: 병합 정렬
description: 배열을 나눈 뒤 정렬된 부분을 병합하는 흐름을 확인합니다.
source_code:
def merge_sort(items):
    if len(items) <= 1:
        return items
    mid = len(items) // 2
    left = merge_sort(items[:mid])
    right = merge_sort(items[mid:])
    result = []
    while left and right:
        result.append(left.pop(0) if left[0] <= right[0] else right.pop(0))
    return result + left + right

print(merge_sort([5, 2, 4, 1]))

title: 보간 탐색
description: 값의 분포를 이용해 예상 위치를 계산하며 탐색합니다.
source_code:
numbers = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
target = 40
low, high = 0, len(numbers) - 1
found = -1
while low <= high and numbers[low] <= target <= numbers[high]:
    pos = low + (target - numbers[low]) * (high - low) // (numbers[high] - numbers[low])
    if numbers[pos] == target:
        found = pos
        break
    if numbers[pos] < target:
        low = pos + 1
    else:
        high = pos - 1
print(found)

title: 다익스트라 최단 경로
description: 가장 가까운 정점을 먼저 확정하며 최단 거리를 갱신합니다.
source_code:
import heapq

graph = {
    0: [(1, 7), (2, 9), (5, 14)],
    1: [(0, 7), (2, 10), (3, 15)],
    2: [(0, 9), (1, 10), (3, 11), (5, 2)],
    3: [(1, 15), (2, 11), (4, 6)],
    4: [(3, 6), (5, 9)],
    5: [(0, 14), (2, 2), (4, 9)],
}

distance = [float('inf')] * 6
distance[0] = 0
heap = [(0, 0)]

while heap:
    cost, node = heapq.heappop(heap)
    if cost > distance[node]:
        continue
    for next_node, weight in graph[node]:
        next_cost = cost + weight
        if next_cost < distance[next_node]:
            distance[next_node] = next_cost
            heapq.heappush(heap, (next_cost, next_node))

print(distance)

title: 프림 MST
description: 하나의 정점에서 시작해 가장 싼 연결 간선을 확장합니다.
source_code:
import heapq
graph = {1: [(1, 2), (3, 3)], 2: [(1, 1), (2, 3)], 3: [(3, 1), (2, 2)]}
visited = set()
heap = [(0, 1)]
total = 0
while heap:
    cost, node = heapq.heappop(heap)
    if node in visited:
        continue
    visited.add(node)
    total += cost
    for weight, next_node in graph[node]:
        heapq.heappush(heap, (weight, next_node))
print(total)

    hanoi(n - 1, start, end, via, moves)
    moves.append((start, end))

title: 배낭 문제
description: 무게 제한 안에서 가치를 최대로 만드는 DP 테이블을 채웁니다.
source_code:
weights = [1, 3, 4]
values = [15, 20, 30]
capacity = 4
dp = [0] * (capacity + 1)
for i in range(len(weights)):
    for w in range(capacity, weights[i] - 1, -1):
        dp[w] = max(dp[w], dp[w - weights[i]] + values[i])
print(dp)

title: 허프만 코딩
description: 빈도가 낮은 노드부터 합치며 prefix code 트리를 만듭니다.
source_code:

heap = [(5, "A"), (9, "B"), (12, "C"), (13, "D")]
heapq.heapify(heap)
while len(heap) > 1:
    first = heapq.heappop(heap)
    second = heapq.heappop(heap)
    merged = (first[0] + second[0], first[1] + second[1])
    heapq.heappush(heap, merged)
